author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Howdy, its zac. I got warned for abusing /report. This is a lie since I never did that. Appeal plx.
body_tagged: Howdy, its zac. I got warned for abusing /report. This is a lie since I never did that. Appeal plx.
title: Appeal my warn plx

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
http://imgur.com/a/WlRzx
Hi zac here is the evidence for your appeal, (although may I point out for warns not required.)
We're mostly referring to the September 5th reports shown.

After reporting me i told you in TeamSpeak to stop, you then continued to report Venny, i told you to stop in ts again. Finally, when you reported pieZ me and you both knew you were having a bit of a joke when reporting him, you knew perfectly well Steven wasn't him, so i warned a bit later after dealing with steven. Either way, the first 2 warrant a warn anyhow; The reason we ask you not to report staff is due to the fact that, one if they were hacking they can just toggle and two it automatically comes across as a joke even if not intended. The best way to report a staff member is to a senior+ ideally with evidence but not required. 

The warn is valid either way as i told you to stop and you did not, therefore:
  1. "These rules are subject to change without notice. Players are responsible for keeping up with rule changes, it is up to you to keep checking the rule page.
Follow the directions given by any Avicus staff member. If you believe a staff member is abusing their power through wrongful punishments or other methods, please email support@avicus.net and provide any evidence or details you possess regarding the staff member."

So if you think I'm abusing please report me to a higher up.
Also, I included you reporting _Distraction_ in the evidence as to justify the minimum you deserve from this is a warn as this also warrants a warn.

Appeal Denied
Will lock in 24 hours from this comment unless response provided.
